style: Toddler coloring book page, ages 2-4. Pure black line art on a pure white background. Extra-thick bold uniform black outlines, like a heavy marker, every shape fully closed so it can be colored in. Big simple chunky shapes and large open areas to color; absolutely no shading, no gray, no hatching, no gradients, no fill, no tiny details, no text, no letters, no numbers. Stylized hero-shot design: exaggerated chunky toy-like proportions, oversized wheels, dynamic low three-quarter angle so it feels powerful and fun, like a premium modern kids' illustration. One main subject, centered, large, filling most of the page, fully inside the frame with a clean white margin all around. Only a few simple bold background shapes (ground line, a couple of clouds or rocks). Cute friendly original animal driver with big round eyes and a happy smile, visible in the cab. The vehicle itself has no face.
